definitions.gloss: to fold; to bend; to crease
definitions.explanation: To bend something by folding, typically paper, metal, or body parts like knees or fingers.

examples.japanese: {紙|かみ}を{半分|はんぶん}に{折|お}り{曲|ま}げた。
examples.english: I folded the paper in half.

examples.japanese: {膝|ひざ}を{折|お}り{曲|ま}げて{座|すわ}ってください。
examples.english: Please sit with your knees bent.

examples.japanese: {針金|はりがね}を{折|お}り{曲|ま}げて{形|かたち}を{作|つく}った。
examples.english: I bent the wire and shaped it.

notes:
CONJUGATION:
・{折|お}り{曲|ま}げる → {折|お}り{曲|ま}げない (negative)
・{折|お}り{曲|ま}げる → {折|お}り{曲|ま}げて (te-form)
・{折|お}り{曲|ま}げる → {折|お}り{曲|ま}げた (past)

FORMATION:
Compound verb: {折|お}る (to fold/break) + {曲|ま}げる (to bend)

The combination emphasizes both the folding and bending action.

COLLOCATIONS:
・{紙|かみ}を{折|お}り{曲|ま}げる - to fold paper
・{膝|ひざ}を{折|お}り{曲|ま}げる - to bend one's knees
・{指|ゆび}を{折|お}り{曲|ま}げる - to bend one's fingers
・{針金|はりがね}を{折|お}り{曲|ま}げる - to bend wire

SIMILAR WORDS:
・{折|お}る - to fold, to break
・{曲|ま}げる - to bend
